varieties.supplier_notes: Orange-fleshed (OFSP), vitamin A; premium from institutional buyers.

timeline_template.description_en: Ridge up 90-100 cm apart — flat planting means small roots and weevil entry points.
timeline_template.description_sw: Tengeneza matuta 90-100 cm kati — kupanda tambarare kunaleta mizizi midogo na njia za wadudu.

timeline_template.description_en: Plant 3-node vine cuttings, 2 nodes buried, 30 cm in-row (~14,000 cuttings per acre).
timeline_template.description_sw: Panda vipandikizi vya mizabibu vyenye vifundo 3, 2 chini, sentimita 30 kwa mstari.
timeline_template.tip_en: Skip heavy nitrogen — it grows vines at the expense of roots.
timeline_template.tip_sw: Usiweke mbolea ya nitrojeni nyingi — inalisha mizabibu, si mizizi.

timeline_template.description_en: First weeding; re-hill any exposed roots.
timeline_template.description_sw: Palia kwanza; pandia udongo mizizi iliyojitokeza.

timeline_template.description_en: Scout for weevil — cracked soil at the ridge base is the tell. Keep cracks covered.
timeline_template.description_sw: Chunguza wadudu — nyufa za udongo kwenye tuta ni dalili. Funika nyufa.

timeline_template.description_en: Harvest piecemeal from 3.5-5 months — dig what you need, leave the rest in the ground.
timeline_template.description_sw: Vuna kidogokidogo kuanzia miezi 3.5-5 — chimba unachohitaji, acha kingine ardhini.
timeline_template.tip_en: Don't leave roots in-ground past 5 months — weevil damage climbs sharply.
timeline_template.tip_sw: Usiache mizizi ardhini zaidi ya miezi 5 — uharibifu wa wadudu unaongezeka.

post_harvest.grading_criteria: Grade by root size and skin condition; OFSP by colour depth. Reject weevil-damaged roots.
post_harvest.packaging_standard: 50 kg bags or crates; cure lightly in shade before transport.
post_harvest.storage_tips_en: In-ground piecemeal harvest IS the storage system — no warehouse needed.
post_harvest.storage_tips_sw: Kuvuna kidogokidogo ardhini NDIO hifadhi — haihitaji ghala.

diseases.symptoms_en: Larvae tunnel roots and vines, root surface pimpled with exit holes, bitter taste, storage rot.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Viluwiluwi hutoboa mizizi, matundu kwenye ngozi, ladha chungu, kuoza.
diseases.treatment_en: None effective post-infestation — harvest on time, destroy infested material. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Hakuna dawa baada ya kuambukizwa — vuna kwa wakati, teketeza vilivyoathirika. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_en: Cover ridge cracks, piecemeal harvest before 5 months, rotation, clean vines.
diseases.prevention_sw: Funika nyufa, vuna kabla ya miezi 5, zungusha, mizabibu safi.
diseases.scanner_notes: Photograph ridge base cracks + cut root surface — leaf photos miss it.

diseases.symptoms_en: Stunted plants, small crinkled leaves, chlorotic mottling, poor root set.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Mimea dhaifu, majani madogo yaliyokunjana, madoa ya manjano, mizizi midogo.
diseases.treatment_en: None — remove infected plants, control whiteflies early. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Hakuna tiba — ondoa mimea iliyoathirika, dhibiti nzi weupe mapema. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_en: Clean certified vines only, never save vines from infected fields.
diseases.prevention_sw: Mizabibu safi tu, usihifadhi mizabibu ya shamba lililoathirika.
diseases.scanner_notes: Crinkle + stunting pattern; ask about vine source in-app.

diseases.symptoms_en: Knotted galls on roots, stunted patches, roots deformed.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Uvimbe kwenye mizizi, mapande dhaifu, mizizi iliyopinda.
diseases.treatment_en: None curative — rotation is the treatment. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Hakuna tiba — kuzungusha ndio dawa. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_en: Rotate with cereals, avoid after tomato/potato.
diseases.prevention_sw: Zungusha na nafaka, epuka baada ya nyanya/viazi.
diseases.scanner_notes: Photograph washed roots — galls vs weevil tunnels are the discriminator.

diseases.severity_classes: Low (scattered spots) · High (defoliation in wet spells)
diseases.symptoms_en: Brown ringed spots, yellowing, older leaves first.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Madoa ya kahawia yenye pete, kuwitikia, majani makubwa kwanza.
diseases.treatment_en: Registered alternaria-active classes if severe. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Dawa za alternaria zilizoidhinishwa ikithiri. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_en: Row ventilation, avoid overhead watering at night.
diseases.scanner_notes: Ringed spots distinguish from SPVD mottling.

market_notes.sell_windows_en: Piecemeal harvest means you're never forced to sell in a glut — the price floor rarely collapses. OFSP commands the premium with institutional buyers.
market_notes.sell_windows_sw: Kuvuna kidogokidogo kunamaanisha haulazimiki kuuza wakati wa wingi — bei haianguki sana. OFSP ina bei ya juu kwa wakubwa.
market_notes.price_notes_en: Fresh roots 25–60 KES per kg by variety; vines sell to neighbours at planting time (November 2026). Input bill under 10,000 KES per acre.
market_notes.price_notes_sw: Mizizi mibichi KES 25–60 kwa kilo; mizabibu huuzwa kwa majirani wakati wa kupanda (Novemba 2026). Gharama chini ya 10,000 KES kwa eka.
